From: Giles, Stephen <stephen.giles@hawks.com>
Sent: Friday, January 31, 2020 6:39 PM
To: Fenech, Anthony <afenech@freepress.com>
Subject: Re: Hello from Detroit 
 
Hi Anthony,
Welcome to the NBA. I can still be a fan of baseball so we will have that in common. I see the Pistons again on 2/28 in Phoenix in the event you will be there. Feel free to say hello if so.
Good luck in your new role,
My name is Anthony Fenech and I cover the Tigers for the Detroit Free Press. Next month, I’m transitioning to the Pistons and NBA beat and I wanted to reach out and introduce myself.

I’ve covered baseball for my entire career; I know nobody in the league and very little about basketball in general, so I’m starting to build my network with my best relationships in baseball — the scouts.

I’m looking forward to meeting new people and learning the game. If you’re willing to give me a shot, my cell phone number is (734) 752-9667. I will be traveling with the team from mid-February on; if you cross paths with the Pistons, let me know.
Safe travels and good luck the rest of the way.

Anthony Fenech
    Detroit Free Press

I'm attending a wedding in D.C. this weekend and staying until Wednesday to spend some additional time with my girlfriend.
If you have some time, I would love to grab a coffee and introduce myself. If so, let me know of your availability. Hope all is well.
